name: PydanticAI
summary: A pydantic_ai.Agent with plain-text output on the Anthropic provider, one MCPToolset (FastMCP client) per MCP server and a native @agent.tool_plain.
notes: pydantic-ai 2.x removed MCPServerStdio/MCPServerStreamableHTTP; MCPToolset (built on a FastMCP client) is the documented replacement and picks the transport from its argument: a URL means Streamable HTTP, a fastmcp StdioTransport means stdio. The model string 'anthropic:<model>' builds AnthropicProvider, which reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and lets the Anthropic SDK read ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. Output type is plain str, so no output tool is added; the framework always sends an explicit tool_choice {type: auto} (accepted, no shim). The system prompt goes in as instructions (sent as a system text block, trailing whitespace stripped). No cache_control by default, so no prompt caching. max_turns maps to UsageLimits(request_limit=...); exceeding it raises UsageLimitExceeded (the default limit would be 50 requests). MCP tool errors default to tool_error_behavior='retry' (ModelRetry), which counts against the agent's retry budget and can end the run if a tool keeps failing.
